model_annotation: Figure 3(a) illustrates the ratio of MMLU runtime to Vanilla runtime (r.KV) for several models across different token selections. The x-axis is labeled "Sept.L.LM(n=54)" and spans from 1 to 11, with evenly spaced tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "r.KV (%)" and ranges from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100. A solid blue line with circle markers represents the “Vanilla” condition, starting with a value of 77.7% at x=1 and ending at 76.5% at x=11. A dashed red line with star markers corresponds to the “StrML.LM” condition, beginning at 70.89% at x=1 and declining to 70.13% at x=11. A solid green line with diamond markers illustrates the “SepL.LM” condition, starting at 69.67% at x=1 and reaching 69.78% at x=11. A dashed purple line with triangle markers depicts the “SepL.LM(n=54)” condition, which starts at 69.34% at x=1 and ends at 69.83% at x=11. A dotted orange line with square markers represents the “SepL.LM(n=256)” condition, beginning at 77.18% at x=1 and ending at 72.19% at x=11.
